tool_args.rationale: Fit a low-dimensional smooth response to the observed input and gradient variation, then use fresh confirmation to test whether it generalizes. The data do not independently identify horizon or initial-condition effects.

considered_alternatives.option: Hyperbolic queue and linear inventory models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot response is concave in input, while the branch probe shows a substantial gradient effect; neither supplied snapshot law captures both patterns.
All observations have the same horizon and initial conditions, so its temporal parameters cannot be separately identified from these data.
Both relevant probe types have already been acquired; the added trajectory batch did not vary the horizon.
